integrity: A reproducible integer verifier constructs all labelled incidences, tests all 720 symmetries, and computes exact Smith and Hermite normal forms. No geometric/independent audit is implied.
scientific_limitations: Only formal unsigned incidence cokernels of genus-two Jacobian Kummer quartics in odd characteristic are classified; not arithmetic Picard, Chow, Neron-Severi or Brauer groups. Some eleven abstract Frobenius classes may not occur over a particular small finite field. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Integral Frobenius coinvariants of the genus-two Kummer node–trope incidence
